dispatch.below_cutoff: Current production arithmetic, including current low-square leaves
dispatch.odd_scope: Only Toom-4 interpolation divisions by 3, 9 and 15; shared Toom-3 divide_exact is unchanged

exploration.selection: Select only among the six registered combinations at the fixed cutoff 1024. A combination must improve each affected principal workload by at least 3 percent and every affected exploration shape by at least 1 percent versus baseline. Among eligible combinations, choose the least-feature combination within 2 percent geometric-mean elapsed time of the fastest eligible combination. Ties use the registered mode order. If none qualify, archive without default promotion. Exploration is not confirmation.

confirmation.shapes: All registered key shapes plus all exploration shapes, deduplicated; both operations; exact immutable selected arithmetic source
confirmation.acceptance: Both runs must improve each affected principal workload by at least 3 percent, every affected measured shape by at least 1 percent, and the affected-shape geometric mean by at least 5 percent versus baseline. Below cutoff, report every observed regression and require no repeatable regression above 5 percent. Any failed condition prevents promotion. No tuning or result-based rerun after selection.

measurement.order: Mode order rotates by repetition within each shape and operation
measurement.allocation: Same full-u64 operands; preallocated output and exact 12n product / 10n square scratch reused by every mode; black_box inputs and outputs; public GMP full then low copy and top mask
measurement.quiet: Root-coordinated heavy-job stop, Windows process CPU probe and WSL process CPU probe before measurement; retain before/after metadata and all raw records

scope.proof: Same-source full Verus verification and optimized compilation; imported vir/rlib pairs bound to those sources; Python integer oracles, actual semantic VC failures, default and forced paths, exact capacities/canaries and generated-code checks before confirmation
scope.cost: Full Toom-4 analytic majorant 7 T(ceil(n/4)+1)+O(n); no checked composed bit-cost or machine-cost theorem; scratch contracts remain 12n and 10n
